spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates lazy includes over genuinely infinite generators (naturals, fibonacci, squares, primes) with pull counting, the undecidable-absent-value caveat, and the take()-then-includes() guard — the proposal's own motivating semantics.

interactive.rationale: Sequence picker, numeric target and Search run a real counted search; verified 4181 found in the naturals after 4,182 pulls with the eager column honestly reported as not-run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises asking membership of endless sequences without materialising them, which the page demonstrates and correctly bounds.

edge_cases.rationale: The absent-value non-termination is stated as the honest limitation, the eager spread is deliberately not executed with an explanation, and the bounded take() guard is shown as the production pattern.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5205192866922496 and the relevant proposal/spec material.

conformance.rationale: The suite covers presence, SameValueZero, short-circuiting, endless sequences and iterator consumption; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail because Iterator.prototype.includes needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): searched the naturals for 4181 — found after 4,182 pulls in 0.8ms via the clearly-labelled stand-in loop (includes=false, take=true logged), eager row honestly marked 'would never return'; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs per-search sequence/target/pull counts.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, danger note for the not-run eager column, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled number input and sequence list, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/iterator-includes/infinite-sequences/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which predates Iterator.prototype.includes. The page runs its search through an explicitly-labelled equivalent loop ('lazy loop (stand-in)') so the pull-count lesson still lands, refuses to run the tab-killing eager spread and says why, and teaches the take() guard for the undecidable case. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; desktop and mobile screenshots read with no overflow; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail on this build. Clears the bar.
